default.notes: Pre-enrol online for the biometric e-visa (SNEDAI) and collect it on arrival at Abidjan airport — entry by land or through other airports requires an embassy visa instead.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter freely under the Community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days with a valid passport or ECOWAS travel document.
Visa-free for short stays under a bilateral exemption — confirm the exact allowance with an Ivorian mission before travel.

CI.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Ivorian citizens.
